text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Staff are responding to a referral made at the Nov. 5th meeting of Toronto and East York Community Council to report on a detailed breakdown on the recommended fees associated with an application for two commercial boulevard parking spaces on Bedford Ave. and the feasibility of installing a two car loading zone in lieu of the CBP spaces.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until its January 8, 2020 meeting. 2. Requested the Manager, Permits and Enforcement-Parking, Transportation Services to report back to the January 8, 2020 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council with by-law changes for the installation of two loading zones at 170 Bedford Road.
